## Platform Overview

PullNova provides AI-powered tools designed specifically for modern engineering teams that need to ship high-quality software faster. Our platform combines advanced machine learning models with deep developer workflow integrations.

### Core Features

- **AI Code Review**: Real-time pull request analysis that catches bugs, security issues, performance regressions, and code style violations before they reach production. Uses custom-trained models fine-tuned on millions of code reviews.
- **CI/CD Intelligence**: Pipeline optimization through intelligent caching, flaky test detection, build time prediction, and automatic rollback recommendations when deployments show anomalies.
- **Security Scanning**: Comprehensive SAST and DAST analysis covering OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, dependency scanning, secret detection, and license compliance checking.
- **Smart Refactoring**: AI-powered code quality improvements that identify technical debt, suggest structural improvements, and automatically generate refactoring pull requests with detailed explanations.
- **Team Analytics**: DORA metrics tracking, code review turnaround time analysis, code health dashboards, and engineering productivity insights that help teams continuously improve.
- **Deep Integrations**: Native support for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, and more.

### Supported Languages

PullNova supports 30+ programming languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C#, C++, Ruby, PHP, Swift, Kotlin, Scala, Elixir, and many more. Our models are continuously trained on open-source repositories to stay current with language evolution and best practices.

### Pricing Tiers

PullNova offers flexible pricing designed to grow with your team. Our Free tier supports open source projects and individual developers with unlimited public repositories. The Pro plan at $29 per seat per month includes private repositories, custom rules, and priority support. Enterprise plans offer SSO, SLA guarantees, on-premises deployment options, and dedicated support with custom pricing.

### About PullNova

Founded by a team of experienced software engineers and AI researchers, PullNova's mission is to eliminate the friction between writing code and shipping it. We believe that every developer deserves AI assistance that understands their codebase, respects their workflow, and helps them focus on what matters most: building great software.

## Detailed Feature: AI Code Review

PullNova's AI Code Review engine uses custom-trained transformer models fine-tuned on millions of code reviews from open-source and enterprise repositories. The model understands bug detection including null pointer exceptions, off-by-one errors, race conditions, memory leaks, and logic errors. Security analysis covers injection vulnerabilities, XSS, CSRF, insecure deserialization, hardcoded credentials, and all OWASP Top 10 issues. Performance optimization flags inefficient algorithms, N+1 queries, unnecessary allocations, and suboptimal data structures. Style enforcement supports team-specific coding standards, naming conventions, and best practices. Test coverage analysis identifies untested code paths and suggests test cases. The review engine provides detailed explanations in natural language, making it accessible to junior developers while providing depth that senior engineers appreciate.

## Detailed Feature: CI/CD Intelligence

PullNova's CI/CD Intelligence module optimizes continuous integration and deployment pipelines through flaky test detection using machine learning models that identify and track flaky tests across builds with root cause analysis. Build time prediction uses predictive models that estimate build duration based on change sets, enabling better resource allocation. Intelligent caching provides dependency-aware caching that knows which caches to invalidate based on actual code changes. Rollback automation offers automatic detection of deployment anomalies with intelligent rollback recommendations. Pipeline analytics tracks DORA metrics including Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery, and Change Failure Rate with industry benchmarking.

## Detailed Feature: Security Scanning

Comprehensive security analysis combines Static Analysis (SAST) for code-level vulnerability detection across all supported languages, Dynamic Analysis (DAST) for runtime security testing of deployed applications, Dependency Scanning for vulnerability detection in third-party libraries and frameworks, Secret Detection for identification of accidentally committed secrets, API keys, and credentials, and License Compliance for automated license auditing of open-source dependencies. PullNova is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant, with data encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Role-based access control (RBAC) and audit logging are available for all platform actions.

## Team & Company

PullNova was founded in 2022 by Alex Chen (CEO, ex-Google AI), Sarah Rodriguez (CTO, ex-Microsoft Azure), and Marcus Kim (Chief Architect, ex-Meta Infrastructure). Headquartered in San Francisco, California, USA. The engineering team has deep expertise in machine learning, developer tools, and distributed systems. Backed by leading venture capital firms. PullNova serves over 10,000 engineers across companies ranging from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, processing millions of pull requests monthly with an average bug detection rate of 93% and false positive rate below 5%.

## Integration Ecosystem

PullNova integrates with the complete development ecosystem. Version control integrations include GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps. CI/CD integrations include GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, and Travis CI. Communication integrations include Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Discord. Project management integrations include Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion. IDE integrations include VS Code and JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, PyCharm, GoLand). Observability integrations include Datadog, New Relic, and Sentry. The REST API at api.pullnova.com/v1/ uses JSON and authenticates via API keys. Rate limits vary by plan: Free at 100 requests per minute, Pro at 1000, Enterprise custom.

PullNova is built on a cloud-native architecture with GPU-accelerated inference clusters with auto-scaling, an event-driven data pipeline processing millions of PR events daily, and multi-region failover for 99.9% uptime SLA. Enterprise customers can deploy PullNova within their own VPC or data center via the on-premises deployment option.

## API Reference Summary

PullNova provides a comprehensive REST API for programmatic access to all platform features.

### Authentication
All API requests require an API key passed in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. API keys are managed through the PullNova dashboard under Settings > API Keys. Each key is scoped to a specific organization and has configurable permissions including read, write, and admin access levels.

### Core Endpoints

**Pull Request Analysis**
- `POST /v1/analyze/pr` - Submit a pull request for AI review. Returns analysis ID for polling.
- `GET /v1/analyze/pr/{id}` - Get the status and results of a pull request analysis. Results include bug findings, security issues, style violations, and performance concerns.
- `POST /v1/analyze/pr/{id}/recheck` - Re-trigger analysis after code changes.

**CI/CD Pipeline**
- `POST /v1/pipeline/optimize` - Submit a CI/CD pipeline configuration for optimization suggestions. Analyzes caching strategy, parallelization opportunities, and flaky test detection.
- `GET /v1/pipeline/dora` - Retrieve DORA metrics for your team including deployment frequency, lead time for changes, mean time to recovery, and change failure rate.

**Security Scanning**
- `POST /v1/security/scan` - Initiate a comprehensive security scan on a repository or codebase. Covers SAST, DAST, dependency analysis, and secret detection.
- `GET /v1/security/scan/{id}` - Get detailed scan results with severity classifications and remediation guidance.

**Team & Analytics**
- `GET /v1/team/metrics` - Get team-wide engineering metrics including code review turnaround time, PR throughput, and code health scores.
- `GET /v1/team/members` - List team members with their activity summaries and contribution statistics.

### Rate Limits
- Free tier: 100 requests per minute, 1000 requests per day
- Pro tier: 1000 requests per minute, 50000 requests per day
- Enterprise tier: Custom limits with burst support

### Webhooks
PullNova can send real-time event notifications to your configured webhook endpoints. Supported events include: `pr.analysis.completed`, `security.scan.completed`, `pipeline.optimized`, and `test.flaky.detected`. Webhooks are delivered as HTTP POST requests with JSON payloads and include retry logic for failed deliveries.

### SDK Support
PullNova provides official SDKs for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java. Each SDK wraps the REST API with idiomatic interfaces, automatic retry handling, and type-safe request/response objects. Install via pip, npm, go get, or maven respectively.

## Security & Compliance Details

PullNova maintains the highest standards of security and data protection.

### Certifications
- SOC 2 Type II certified with annual audits
- GDPR compliant with Data Processing Agreements available for EU customers
- HIPAA compliance available for Enterprise healthcare customers
- Regular penetration testing by independent third-party security firms

### Data Protection
- All data encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption
- All data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3
- Customer data isolated at the organization level
- Configurable data retention policies
- Data residency options: US, EU, Asia-Pacific regions

### Access Control
- Role-based access control with customizable roles (Admin, Manager, Developer, Viewer)
- SAML/SSO integration with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and other identity providers
- Multi-factor authentication support
- API key rotation policies and audit logging for all authentication events
- IP allowlisting for Enterprise customers

### Compliance Features
- Full audit logging for all platform actions with 90-day retention
- Export capabilities for compliance reporting
- Change management tracking and approval workflows
- Automated policy enforcement for code review and deployment gates

## Getting Started Guide

### Quick Start
1. Sign up at pullnova.com and create your organization
2. Connect your Git provider (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps)
3. Configure your first repository by selecting which analysis types to enable
4. Open a pull request and PullNova will automatically begin analysis
5. Review AI findings directly in your PR comments

### Best Practices
- Start with AI Code Review on a small repository to tune sensitivity settings
- Configure custom rules that match your team's coding standards and conventions
- Integrate with Slack or Microsoft Teams for real-time notifications
- Use the CLI tool for pre-commit analysis to catch issues before pushing
- Review the DORA metrics dashboard weekly to track engineering improvement trends
- Set up webhook integrations for automated workflows and custom notifications
- Use the API for CI/CD pipeline integration and custom dashboard creation
